<h1>Release process</h1>
<p>This checklist is for maintainers preparing a beta or public release.</p>
<section id="pre-release-checks">

<p>Run the standard quality gates from a clean checkout:</p>

python<span class="w"> </span>-m<span class="w"> </span>ruff<span class="w"> </span>check<span class="w"> </span>.

<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>rm<span class="w"> </span>-rf<span class="w"> </span>dist<span class="w"> </span>build<span class="w"> </span>*.egg-info

</pre></div>

<section id="installed-wheel-smoke-test">
<h2>Installed-wheel smoke test</h2>
<p>Always verify the built wheel from outside the source checkout:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>python<span class="w"> </span>-m<span class="w"> </span>venv<span class="w"> </span>/tmp/archledger-wheel-test
/tmp/archledger-wheel-test/bin/python<span class="w"> </span>-m<span class="w"> </span>pip<span class="w"> </span>install<span class="w"> </span>dist/*.whl
/tmp/archledger-wheel-test/bin/python<span class="w"> </span>-I<span class="w"> </span>-<span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&lt;&lt;&#39;PY&#39;</span>
<span class="s">import importlib.metadata</span>
<span class="s">import archledger</span>

<span class="s">assert importlib.metadata.version(&quot;archledger&quot;) == archledger.__version__</span>
<span class="s">print(archledger.__version__)</span>
<span class="s">PY</span>
<span class="nv">workdir</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;</span><span class="k">$(</span>mktemp<span class="w"> </span>-d<span class="k">)</span><span class="s2">&quot;</span>
<span class="nb">cd</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;</span><span class="nv">$workdir</span><span class="s2">&quot;</span>
/tmp/archledger-wheel-test/bin/archledger<span class="w"> </span>--version
/tmp/archledger-wheel-test/bin/archledger<span class="w"> </span>init<span class="w"> </span>--source-format<span class="w"> </span>markdown
/tmp/archledger-wheel-test/bin/archledger<span class="w"> </span>seed<span class="w"> </span>arc42-minimal
/tmp/archledger-wheel-test/bin/archledger<span class="w"> </span>new<span class="w"> </span>requirement<span class="w"> </span>--title<span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Smoke&quot;</span><span class="w"> </span>--status<span class="w"> </span>accepted
/tmp/archledger-wheel-test/bin/archledger<span class="w"> </span>build<span class="w"> </span>--format<span class="w"> </span>markdown

<section id="converter-backed-release-confidence">
<h2>Converter-backed release confidence</h2>
<p>If the release promises converter-backed exports, run the optional integration coverage in an environment with the tools installed:</p>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>python<span class="w"> </span>-m<span class="w"> </span>pytest<span class="w"> </span>-q<span class="w"> </span>-m<span class="w"> </span>integration<span class="w"> </span>tests/test_converter_integration.py
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="release-decision">
<h2>Release decision</h2>
<p>Before tagging or publishing:</p>
<ol class="arabic simple">
<li><p>Confirm the changelog is updated.</p></li>
<li><p>Confirm CI is green on the supported Python versions.</p></li>
<li><p>Confirm the built artifact version matches <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">archledger.__version__</span></code> when installed.</p></li>
<li><p>Confirm the installed console script works outside the repository checkout.</p></li>
</ol>
</section>
